external_system.name: Jev
external_system.official_claim_shape: structured questions -> typed decisions with probabilities/confidence
external_system.verification: official TypeSafe site observed; community integration evidence exists but is not treated as provider authority

hypothesis: A specialized typed probabilistic decision model may complement rather than replace generative/deep-reasoning work, especially for candidate routing, gating and repeated low-cost judgments.

placement.authority: advisory-only; cannot control official output or side effects

required_before_live_connection: verify official API/SDK contract and current data policy
obtain authorized credential through a secret-safe connector path; never commit keys
define redacted synthetic fixtures before any user-source material
record latency/cost/version/provider provenance for every live judgment

isolated_eval_plan.shadow: same frozen state/questions passed to Jev where answer space is finite
three_layers: L2 held-out correctness/calibration versus frozen labels
L3 cross-organ practical utility: error, latency, cost, escalation quality
isolated_eval_plan.cross_food: must include material unrelated to Freud, geography and traffic
isolated_eval_plan.failure_rule: low confidence, drift, unavailable provider, schema mismatch or missing provenance falls back to existing path; never fabricate a decision

claim_boundary: This artifact only registers an evidence-backed connector candidate and test contract. Jev has not been connected, benchmarked by this repo, incorporated, or shown superior.
next_required: build secret-free mock adapter matching the typed decision contract
run frozen synthetic A/B fixtures against existing decision path
only then consider an authorized live Shadow call
